title: WindowTrackEntry
description: One per-window record emitted by the recognition backbone (or the Phase-1 oracle). A 'track' is a JSON Lines file where each line validates against this schema. This is the sole artifact crossing the A-to-B boundary.

window_id.description: Stable identifier for this window within the recording, e.g. 'w000123'.

t_start.description: Window start, seconds from start of recording (frozen time base, TASKS.md §0).

t_end.description: Window end, seconds from start of recording. Must exceed t_start.

probs.description: Class probabilities in the canonical order: LYING, SITTING, STANDING_STILL, STANDING_MOVING, WALKING, RUNNING, BICYCLING.

coverage.description: Fraction of this window backed by real, non-imputed samples. 1.0 means no gap-filling occurred anywhere in the window.

feature_summary.description: Named signal-property values B cites verbatim in explanations (PRD §4.3, §4.4). Key names are part of the A-B contract; do not rename without a joint commit.

model_id.description: Identifies which model/config produced this window, e.g. 'full', 'oracle', 'quant8'.
